en.headline: Frieren anime exhibition opens at Mong Kok INCUBASE Arena
en.dek: The Beyond Journey's End exhibition runs until 3 January at Chong Hing Square B2, with five themed areas from the first season and tickets from HK$108.
body: Organisers said the Frieren: Beyond Journey's End exhibition opened on 24 November at INCUBASE Arena on the B2 level of Chong Hing Square in Mong Kok.

The show features five themed areas recreating scenes from the anime's first season, including a Hong Kong-exclusive photo spot. It is open from noon to 10pm on weekdays and from 11am to 10pm on weekends and public holidays, with last entry at 9pm.
Single tickets cost HK$128 during the run, with other options starting from HK$108. The exhibition continues until 3 January 2027.

zh.headline: 《葬送的芙莉蓮》特展旺角開幕 展至明年1月
zh.dek: 展覽於11月24日在旺角創興廣場地庫INCUBASE Arena開始，設五個第一季主題展區，門票由108元起，展至明年1月3日。
body: 主辦單位表示，《葬送的芙莉蓮》特展已於11月24日在旺角創興廣場地庫B2層的INCUBASE Arena開幕。
展覽以動畫第一季為主軸，設五個主題展區重現相關場面，並有香港站限定拍照位置。平日中午12時至晚上10時開放，周末及公眾假期上午11時至晚上10時，最後入場時間為晚上9時。
展期單人票價為128元，其他票種由108元起。展覽將持續至2027年1月3日。
